tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. The cool grey-green of a microscope slide, never cream.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the Atlas grid tiles, the sidenote popover on phones.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Sidebar table of contents, figure mats, code and data panels.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All running text and headings, on paper, raised and sunk.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, sidenote body, inactive nav items, on paper, raised and sunk.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: section breaks, table rows. Never a control border.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, buttons, the Atlas filter chips. 3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Rhodopsin (visual purple). Links, citation markers, the focus ring, the reading-progress bar. On paper, raised, sunk.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Highlight behind the sidenote or footnote a reader has just jumped to. Ink and accent both read on it.

tokens.name: part-1
tokens.usage: Part I, Foundations. The 420 nm short-wave cone peak. Part labels, chapter numerals, TOC markers.

tokens.name: part-1-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for Part I chapter-opener bands; part-1 text reads on it.

tokens.name: part-2
tokens.usage: Part II, From light patch to image. The 498 nm rod (rhodopsin) peak.

tokens.name: part-2-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for Part II chapter-opener bands; part-2 text reads on it.

tokens.name: part-3
tokens.usage: Part III, The diversity of eyes. The 534 nm medium-wave cone peak.

tokens.name: part-3-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for Part III chapter-opener bands; part-3 text reads on it.

tokens.name: part-4
tokens.usage: Part IV, Imperfection and trade-off. The 564 nm long-wave cone peak.

tokens.name: part-4-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for Part IV chapter-opener bands; part-4 text reads on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a solid accent fill (the primary button).

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "Arial Narrow", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: chapter-title
styles.usage: One per page: the chapter, Atlas entry or claim title.

styles.name: standfirst
styles.usage: The one-paragraph summary under a chapter title.
styles.sample: The vertebrate eye was rebuilt from a single eye on top of the head.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All running text. 19px is deliberate: this is a book read for twenty minutes at a time.
styles.sample: The hagfish eye has no lens, no muscles and the simplest retina of any vertebrate.

styles.name: sidenote
styles.usage: Citations and asides in the right margin.
styles.sample: Lamb, Collin & Pugh 2007, Nat Rev Neurosci 8:960.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Figure captions, under the figure number.
styles.sample: The eye of a hagfish, sectioned.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase part labels and eyebrows. Set in capitals in markup.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Table of contents, previous/next, Atlas filters.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a citation marker and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a figure and its caption.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs groups and list items in navigation.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a section title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Above a part or chapter break; between page regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Chapter opener top padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. Figures, cards, panels: square, like a printed plate.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the Atlas filter chips.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Wavelength tags only (the part marker).

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Width of the reading column in body type (about 66 characters).

tokens.name: margin-column
tokens.usage: Right margin for sidenotes on wide screens.

tokens.name: toc-width
tokens.usage: Left table-of-contents sidebar.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Only the sidenote popover on phones. Everything else sits flat.
